info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Settlement Id-spec
info.description: The Settlement Management API allows users to efficiently manage payment transactions associated with settlements. Through this API, consumers can delete specific payment transactions by providing the relevant settlement ID, ensuring that erroneous or redundant entries can be cleanly removed from the system. This functionality is essential for financial institutions and payment processors seeking to maintain accurate records and optimize their transaction workflows. Typical users include financial analysts and operations teams tasked with maintaining settlement accuracy.

delete.summary: Remove a settlement by its ID.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific settlement identified by its unique ID. Ensure that the settlement is not referenced by any other records before deletion to maintain data integrity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary information for the deletion of the settlement identified by the specified resource ID. Ensure that the request adheres to the schema defined for this operation.
